$comment: The line every fixture in qa/fixtures/ shares.
IT IS VERTICAL, and that is not a typo. Every fixture moves LEFT TO RIGHT, so a
horizontal line would never be crossed by anything and every run would report
zero events with no error at all — which is the single most expensive silence in
this module, and the one this lab exists to make impossible to mistake for a
`classes` contains `motion` and it is not a typo either. It is the class the
novelty engine emits for a region it measured with pure-Go arithmetic, and a zone
declares WHICH CLASSES MAY CROSS IT. With `car,truck,bus` here and the shipped
trigger emitting `motion`, every candidate was refused as `outside every permitted
polygon` — the same silence as before, one layer down.
The taxonomy has no word for a localised change, so a reference-mode fixture's zone
names `camera_integrity` and this one names `motion`. Both are the detector's own
word for what it found, and the zone file is where an operator says which of those
words counts as an incident at this camera.
note: Vertical, at the middle. Read off the frame, and verified by S1 producing an event.
